questions.stem: A $100 \mathrm{~m}$ long wire having cross-sectional area $6.25 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~m}^2$ and Young's modulus is $10^{10}$ $\mathrm{Nm}^{-2}$ is subjected to a load of $250 \mathrm{~N}$, then the elongation in the wire will be :
questions.solution: Young's modulus gives $Y=FL/(A\Delta L)$. Therefore $\Delta L=250\times100/[(6.25\times10^{-4})(10^{10})]=4\times10^{-3}\,\mathrm m$.
